content:
From today, iPhone users who have installed the Suno app can generate songs through text or voice prompts within the Messages app. Details below.

Suno Brings Song Generation to iMessage

Suno is currently one of the most popular AI song generation platforms, with over 2 million paying subscribers and 7 million songs generated daily.

In addition to its web platform, Suno also has an iPhone app that allows users to create and remix AI songs through text, recordings, or uploaded audio and video. It also features user-created song collections, editor picks, and genre-based playlists.

Now, Suno users can also create songs directly within Apple's Messages app. After installing the Suno app, Suno will appear in the Messages app drawer alongside other iMessage apps, allowing users to generate songs via text prompts or voice memos without leaving the conversation.

Here's a demo of the feature in action:

Suno says users can select a genre before generating a song and can also regenerate to explore different versions before sending.

One potential limitation is that, according to Suno, both users need to have the app installed to use this feature. However, for users who enjoy AI song creation, downloading this free app shouldn't be much of a barrier.

Download Suno on the App Store.
